notes.title: Hi-Score Recorder Update 1.01
notes.content:
Hi-Score Recorder Update 1.01

- Added a menu bar on top
- Removed big labels and replaced them with smaller ones
- You can now access all program options from the top menu bar
- Sort buttons and save and load buttons have been removed
- List fields have been widen to support room for up and down scroll bars
- Loops sort option fixed
